summary: Windows integration tests need a non-production Windows host with PowerShell Remoting enabled and an inventory.winrm file, then run ansible-test windows-integration.
questions: How do I run Ansible's Windows integration tests?
How do I set up the WinRM inventory for testing?

answer_card.title: Windows integration tests
answer_card.answer_md:
Use a non-production Windows Server.
```shell-session
# on the Windows host
Enable-PSRemoting -Force
# on the controller
cp inventory.winrm.template inventory.winrm
${EDITOR:-vi} inventory.winrm
ansible-test windows-integration -v shippable/
```
